heading: The 'rebel' hit by rebellion: How Mamata's TMC journey has come full circle
author: Times of India Editorial
paragraphs: Nearly three decades after Mamata Banerjee broke away from the Congress to build the Trinamool Congress, she finds herself in a very different battle: fighting a rebellion within her own party, a dispute over its name and symbol, and a stronger BJP in Bengal has pushed back to the 'sister party'.
